title: Recovery-Oriented Sock Partnerships
description:
Recovery footwear is quickly becoming as essential to athletes as a reliable pair of running shoes, bridging the gap between performance and restoration.

Designed to reduce fatigue, support tired muscles, and promote overall foot health, these shoes are tailored for the moments after intense training or competition.

As athletes and everyone with a passion for movement prioritizes holistic wellness and injury prevention, recovery footwear is no longer an afterthought—it’s a vital part of living an active lifestyle. With advanced cushioning, ergonomic designs, and breathable materials, these shoes help optimize recovery, making them a must-have for anyone serious about performance and longevity in their sport. description:

The Sculpt Anywhere campaign calls attention to Pvolve's Travel Bundle, which includes five key pieces of the brand's signature equipment. This includes resistance bands, gliders, and the P.3 Trainer, along with a durable neoprene carrying case and a three-month streaming membership. With the Travel Bundle, users will be able to access over 1,500 on-demand classes, ranging from five to 60 minutes in length, from any location. Additionally, the Sculpt Anywhere campaign features a 14-day fitness challenge, running from May 1st until May 14th, that encourages participants to complete eight workouts modeled after Aniston’s personal routine.

title: Strategic Golf-Centric Partnerships
description:
Bank of America's Golf with Us campaign is a nationwide initiative aimed at making golf more accessible and affordable for young players aged six to 18. The program is running in partnership with Youth on Course, a nonprofit organization dedicated to expanding youth access to golf.

The Golf with Us campaign offers a free one-year membership that will enable youth to play at over 2,000 affiliated courses for $5 or less per round. It rotates around a statue currently in Milan at the Pinacoteca di Brera gallery as a part of Milan Design Week. It features a revolving cylindrical sculpture measuring 18 meters in diameter with angled mirror planes made to reflect the sun and emit light to the courtyard.

Devlin explained to Dezeen, "The sculpture works as something to walk past and take in as you make your way around it to the library or art museum. It also works as a 'ride', like a funfair carousel, and also like a show, at night, with an audience gathered to sit and listen to a story, as we all did when we were children. title: eSports-Grade Mobile Controllers
description:
Razer has officially launched its PC Remote Play service, a platform designed to stream PC games directly to mobile devices. This service supports both iOS and Android devices and is compatible with various controllers, including Razer's Kishi series. The platform allows users to access their entire PC game library, including titles from Steam, Epic Games Store, and PC Game Pass, without being restricted to fixed aspect ratios. By leveraging the AV1 video codec, the service enhances visual quality and reduces latency, ensuring a smooth gaming experience. Additionally, the system automatically optimizes resolution and refresh rates to match the capabilities of the connected mobile device.

The setup process for Razer PC Remote Play involves installing the Razer Nexus and PC Remote Play apps on the mobile device and enabling the service through the Razer Cortex software on the host PC. Users can then pair their devices using a Razer ID. The service also supports advanced features such as Sensa HD Haptics for immersive tactile feedback on compatible controllers. With its focus on portability and accessibility, Razer PC Remote Play aims to provide gamers with the flexibility to enjoy high-fidelity gaming experiences on the go. This launch follows a successful beta phase introduced at CES 2025, reflecting Razer's commitment to enhancing the gaming ecosystem.

Today’s diners crave variety and customization, and sauces offer a simple yet exciting way to shake up familiar items like nuggets, fries, and sandwiches without straying too far from what they love. title: Minimal-Ingredient Pantry Staples
description:
Many health-conscious consumers are going back to basics by investing in simple, minimal-ingredient products that are naturally nourishing and not heavily processed. This shift is happening in response to the better-for-you space becoming cluttered with a barrage of claims—protein-rich, keto-friendly, vegan, gluten-free, low-carb—that, while well-intentioned, often leave people feeling overwhelmed and skeptical.

Rather than chasing the next big label, today’s shoppers are prioritizing transparency, clean formulations, and foods and beverages that deliver satisfying flavor and texture without additives. This growing rejection of ultra-processed foods reflects a desire for authenticity and a return to real, recognizable ingredients that feel both wholesome and trustworthy.

title: Youth-Supporting Esports Opportunities
description:
The UK-based charity Ygam has launched an esports and gaming harm prevention programme aimed at safeguarding young people engaged in gaming and esports activities. This initiative is designed to educate and support not only young gamers but also parents, carers, and industry professionals. The programme addresses a range of topics, including microtransactions, advertising, and career opportunities in esports, with the goal of fostering a safer and more supportive environment. Following a successful pilot at the Sheffield United Community Foundation and Sheffield Hallam University, the programme has been well-received by both staff and participants. Ygam emphasizes the importance of equipping young people with the knowledge and tools to navigate gaming safely, aligning with its broader mission to prevent gaming and gambling-related harm.

The programme includes open sessions scheduled throughout April and May 2025, offering resources and training tailored to various stakeholders. It builds on Ygam's three-year strategy, introduced in 2023, to address the risks associated with gaming and gambling among children and young people. The charity reports that 96% of participants in its initiatives gain a better understanding of how to stay safe while gaming. This effort is part of a growing focus on safeguarding within the esports and gaming sectors, with other organizations, such as Fnatic and Guild Esports, also implementing similar policies. Ygam's approach highlights the evolving need for harm prevention strategies as gaming continues to play a central role in the digital lives of young people.

title: AI Video Cloning
description:
Iris, developed by Spot AI, is described as the world's first universal AI agent builder for security cameras. This tool enables businesses to create customized video AI agents through a conversational interface, eliminating the need for technical expertise. Iris builds upon Spot AI's previous launch of out-of-the-box Video AI Agents for safety, security, and operations, offering greater flexibility for industry-specific challenges. Users can train Iris using reinforcement techniques, providing examples of desired and undesired detections, and configure it to trigger real-world responses such as shutting down equipment, locking doors, or generating alerts. This approach significantly reduces the time required to develop specialized video detection systems, making advanced AI capabilities accessible to a broader range of organizations.

Designed for industries such as manufacturing, logistics, retail, construction, and healthcare, Iris leverages security cameras and custom video AI models to monitor physical spaces, reason about events, and take actions in real time. The system supports various use cases, including detecting safety hazards, operational inefficiencies, and security threats. For example, Iris can identify missing safety gear, monitor shelf stock levels, or detect fluid leaks in manufacturing settings. Spot AI emphasizes that Iris transforms video data into actionable insights through natural language interaction, streamlining processes and enhancing productivity across departments. This innovation aligns with Spot AI's broader mission to make video data more accessible and impactful in physical environments.

With millions of homeowners priced out of professional services and turning to DIY platforms like Pinterest and Houzz for inspiration, Mondän offers a middle ground that meets the need for fast, affordable design solutions.

Mondän sets itself apart by delivering complete, professionally designed rooms that can be explored in 360-degree views. With a design package, customers get a curated, shoppable product list tailored to the dimensions of their real-world space, style preferences, and budget.

With this intuitive platform, style seekers can access professional, practical, and personal guidance without steep price tags. Mondän also offers flexible Seasonal Edits so that special touches like decor and accessories can be refreshed without replacing major furniture pieces.
references:

title: Tween-Oriented Content Series
description:
Inspired by the creativity of Gen Z, blinger—the world's first and only patented styling tool that effortlessly and instantly adds gems to hair—launched the Gem Z Collection.

The blinger Gem Z Starter Set pairs a pastel-colored styling tool with 75 precision-cut glass crystals to add sparkle to hair for concerts, nights out, or everyday self-expression. blinger's patented styling tool works without heat, harmful glues, or electricity, and the crystals stay in place thanks to a proprietary adhesive on the underside. As such, removing them is as easy as brushing them out.

The blinger Gem Z Starter Set with blinger Styling Tool + 75 Precision-Cut Glass Crystals can be purchased in three colors: Twinkle Blue, Sea Lavender, or Pale Pink.

title: Chocolate Mint Cookie Shakes
description:
These new Wendy's desserts are headed to the brand's participating locations as a series of sweet, textural frozen treat options that build on the popularity of the Frosty. The treats come in the form of the Frosty Swirls and the Frosty Fusions, which are arriving this April and May, respectively. The Frosty Swirls consist of the original Frosty paired with sweet sauce in three options including Strawberry, Caramel and Brownie Batter. The Frosty Fusions, on the other hand, feature the Frosty mixed with textural treats in three options including Pop-Tarts, Oreo and Caramel Crunch.

Chief Marketing Officer Lindsay Radkoski commented on the new Frosty Swirls and Frosty Fusions Wendy's desserts saying, "We know consumers are always on the lookout for new flavors and ways to customize their order with sauces and mix-ins. We can't wait for everyone to experience even more ways to enjoy our iconic Frosty!"

title: Asian-Fusion Dining Experiences
description:
Café Boulud, the French brasserie by Chef Daniel Boulud, offers a seasonally-changing menu that highlights French culinary traditions in the heart of Toronto. This dynamic menu blends classic brasserie favorites with modern interpretations inspired by Chef Boulud’s family meals in Lyon, providing a contemporary take on timeless dishes.

Central to the dining experience is a gleaming rotisserie, used to slow roast signature dishes like chicken à la broche and whole duck. The restaurant operates daily for breakfast, with lunch and dinner services from Monday through Saturday, and brunch available on the weekends. Additionally, a number of seats are reserved for walk-in guests each evening, accommodating spontaneous visits.

The restaurant’s interior, designed by London-based designer Martin Brudnizki, evokes a classic-era aesthetic as the space includes "a comfortable lounge, wraparound banquettes, a dining bar counter, and a semi-private room that accommodates up to 10 guests." For those seeking a more casual experience, d|bar, located on the ground floor, offers an array of classic and creative cocktails, along with a menu of small plates and complete meals.

Image Credit: Café Boulud
references:
Debra John — April 10, 2025 — World

title: Traditional Indonesian Tempeh Ranges
description:
The Tiba Tempeh Smoky Block is the latest creation from the UK-based brand that's crafted with smoky flavor in the spotlight to work well for a wide range of recipes. The product features the brand's signature tempeh recipe that has been infused with a smoky marinade to give it a deeper, richer flavor profile that works well in stir-fries, sandwiches, pastas and more. The product comes in 220-gram packs, which is arriving on Ocado starting April 18 before heading to Sainsbury's and Waitrose later this month.

Co-Founder Alexandra Longton spoke on the Tiba Tempeh Smoky Block saying, "We’re so excited to launch our new Smoky Tempeh as a natural extension to our best-selling Original Block. We’ve crafted the tastiest protein-packed tempeh, which we know consumers will love. We think this is the tastiest tempeh on the market, and we can’t wait for people to try it.”

Image Credit: Tiba Tempeh

Michael Hemsworth — April 10, 2025 — Lifestyle

title: Pet-Pleasing Frozen Treats
description:
Langham’s Cuisine Doggy Ice Cream is available in two pet-approved flavors, Pea & Vanilla and Carrot & Apple, both made with real fruit and vegetables. The 100% plant-based frozen treats for dogs are a sweet, cooling snack for pups to enjoy as temperatures rise this spring and summer. This pet-safe version of a beloved treat for people avoids certain ingredients commonly found in human ice cream, such as sweeteners and dairy.

Pet food and treats are becoming increasingly human-like as pet owners seek treats for their dogs that mimic their favorite snacks in format, flavor and texture. Doggy Ice Cream is now back at Aldi following popular demand. When it was first launched, 30 tubs flew off shelves every minute.

title: Family-Friendly Ready Meal Ranges
description:
Young’s Breaded Fish with Flavour range is a new lineup of frozen fish products crafted with premium flavor in the spotlight to help reinvigorate the category. The products consists of extra-large fish fillets that have been breaded and covered in ample seasoning to give them just the right level of crunch and flavor in every bite. The products come in two varieties including Garlic & Herb and Paprika & Pepper, which both come with two fillets in each box and are arriving now at Iceland in the UK for £4 with additional retailers receiving stock later this month.

Interim Marketing Controller Matthew Wilson commented on the Young’s Breaded Fish with Flavour range saying, "Breaded fish has long been a staple in the seafood aisle, but it’s been missing the excitement of bolder flavours. We’ve seen great success innovating in battered fish, so we wanted to bring that same perspective to the breaded category. These flavours did exceptionally well in consumer testing, and we’re confident they’ll bring fresh energy to the category while helping retailers attract new shoppers."

title: Three-Way Collaborative Retro Sneakers
description:
Reebok and Tokyo-based fashion label White Mountaineering present the second installment of their collaborative partnership with the release of the 'Reebok x White Mountaineering Classic Leather' sneakers. This exclusive launch merges Reebok’s longstanding heritage in performance footwear with White Mountaineering’s distinctive emphasis on outdoor functionality and modern design aesthetics.

The Classic Leather model in this collaboration has been reimagined to highlight both form and utility. Key design features include "a White Mountaineering-inspired upper, a custom tongue label, tonal laces, a bespoke footbed, and a soft terry lining." Each pair is delivered in a specially designed box, reinforcing the refined and premium character of the collaboration.

Crafted to meet the demands of both urban and outdoor environments, this release exemplifies a blend of technical sensibility and contemporary styling. Moreover, it serves as a refined footwear option for those who appreciate elevated design rooted in functionality.

title: Affordable Nourishing Lip Serums
description:
This Gen Z beauty innovation round-up showcases youthful skincare formulations with vibrant packaging that captivates attention and an affordable price tag — from Evereden’s 'Main Character,' 'Darling,' and 'Supernova' scents to Daise's mood-matching fragrances.

Canadian beauty brand Bubble Skincare stands out in the Gen Z beauty innovation list with its refreshing Spring collection. Packaged in modern containers with playful branding, the company's Fresh Start Gel Cleanser and Soft Launch Hydrating Cream Cleanser cater to individuals seeking affordable, lightweight, effective, and gentle application experiences. Bubble Skincare's key chain lip balms, on the other hand, deliver customizable on-the-go convenience. Burt's Bees also ensures nourished lips with its portable and powerful Shea + Hyaluronic Acid Plumping Lip Serum.

Elsewhere in the Gen Z beauty innovation round-up, Faeves captures attention with its whimsical cat-shaped LED acne patch, which is designed to actively reduce blemishes and prevent acne.

description:
Montegrappa has partnered with Warner Bros. Discovery to create a limited edition writing instrument that celebrates the Flash's 85th anniversary. The collaboration effectively merges high-end Italian craftsmanship with iconic superhero aesthetics.

The Flash-inspired pens showcase meticulous design elements that reference the Scarlet Speedster's attributes. The level of attention to detail is truly mesmerizing. The crimson resin barrels of the writing instruments feature golden enamel fissures that mimic the superhero's speed force energy trails. description:
The Shea + Hyaluronic Acid Plumping Lip Serum by Burt's Bees combines cosmetic enhancement with skincare benefits in a natural and affordable formulation. The product delivers a semi-sheer color on the lip with a high-shine finish. The brand incorporates hydrating actives like hyaluronic acid for moisture retention and menthol for a mild plumping effect. Shea butter and mango extracts are also integrated into the formulation for additional conditioning to soften lips.

As part of Burt's Bees' clean beauty positioning, the multi-functional formula excludes parabens, phthalates, petrolatum, and SLS. title: Ergonomic Urbanite Bike Helmets
description:
The Woolf Smart Folding Helmet has generated remarkable early success on Kickstarter, surpassing its funding goal within three hours and tripling its target within days. This demonstrates strong market interest in its innovative approach to rider safety and convenience.

The Woolf Smart Folding Helmet combines three key advancements — extreme portability through a collapsible design that reduces to just over three inches, advanced impact protection via Energy Reduction Technology developed with safety specialists, and integrated smart features including motion-activated turn signals and crash detection alerts.

The helmet's technical specifications suggest meaningful improvements over conventional options. The designers claim that the folding helmet's polymer-based ERT system addresses both rotational and linear forces during impacts, while the hands-free signaling system could enhance urban cycling safety by eliminating the need for manual gestures.

This is a notable efficiency gain in an industry where paperwork and deadlines are constant challenges.

Trackxi's new AI-powered features could prove valuable for various stakeholders in real estate transactions. The new products for the upcoming gaming console offer protection, charging, and portability. Those prioritizing device safety can choose from varying levels of protection — from heavy-duty shells to minimalist covers

Physicl retail spaces for Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group, on the other hand, have been reimagined through immersive stores in key markets like Hong Kong and Shnanghai. According to the brand, the interactive elements in its retail location have demonstrably increased foot traffic and market share.

title: Feline Disease-Focused Partnerships
description:
As a newly established non-profit organization, Helen’s Pink Sky Foundation is dedicated to advancing research and providing support for individuals and families affected by Batten disease, a rare and devastating neurodegenerative disorder. The charitable organization was founded in response to three-year-old Helen Born’s diagnosis with Late Infantile Batten Disease (CLN2).

Batten Disease causes progressive neurological deterioration, including vision loss, seizures, and cognitive decline. It currently has no cure, though existing therapies can modestly slow its progression. Helen’s Pink Sky Foundation seeks to accelerate the development of innovative treatments, including gene therapy and enzyme replacement approaches, while also offering resources to families affected by the neurodegenerative disorder. By funding scientific research and fostering community support networks, the organization aims to improve both the quality of life and the long-term outcomes for patients.

title: Plant-Focused LED Lighting Systems
description:
BusGates is addressing school bus safety concerns through a new pilot program that provides complimentary LED stop arm extensions to school districts during National Distracted Driving Awareness Month. The innovative extensions physically project five feet from the bus side, creating both a visual and physical barrier to deter motorists from illegally passing stopped buses.

This school bus safety initiative responds to alarming data revealing over 43.5 million illegal bus passings annually, as reported by transportation authorities. The illuminated extensions serve as a proactive alternative to after-the-fact camera enforcement systems. Another key benefit of the LED stop arm extensions is that they are relatively cost-effective to implement. For the month of April, BusGates is shipping one patented stop arm extension to participating schools at no cost.

title: Tropically Flavored Hydration Solutions
description:
High Carb Fuel by Tailwind Nutrition is presented as a specialized sports drink mix engineered to meet the demanding energy requirements of endurance athletes during high-intensity activities. The formulation is supported by sports science to enhance energy absorption while reducing digestive discomfort.

High Carb Fuel delivers 90 grams of carbohydrates per serving in an optimized 2:1 glucose-to-fructose ratio. It is enhanced with 660mg of sodium and 90mg of potassium. This enables the sports drink mix to serve as a fuel source and an electrolyte replenishment system. In doing so, the formulation addresses two critical needs for competitive cyclists, runners, and triathletes.

Tailwind Nutrition developed High Carb Fuel through collaboration with elite athletes and extensive field testing. The product is available in Ginger Lime and Lemonade variants.

description:
Heineken has introduced an innovative 'Starring Bars' program designed to provide financial support to the hospitality industry by transforming bars into potential film sets. As part of its broader 'Back the Bars' initiative, the campaign creates a global online catalog of Heineken-serving bars that production teams can easily browse when scouting authentic locations for movies, TV shows, or commercials. By redirecting location rental budgets typically spent on studio sets toward real bars, the program offers venue owners an additional revenue stream while preserving the genuine atmosphere filmmakers often seek. The Starring Bars includes a promotional campaign featuring bar owners and mobile billboards in entertainment districts that serve to encourage directors to consider these establishments for shoots.

title: Indiana-Distilled 10-Year Bourbons
description:
Rolling Fork Spirits has unveiled the second batch of its Bourbon de Luxe Kentucky Straight Bourbon, continuing the revival of this historic whiskey brand. The limited release consists of just 1,116 bottles of eight-year-old bourbon sourced from Bardstown distilleries and bottled at cask strength (119 proof) to preserve its robust character. The flavor profile showcases a harmonious blend of sweet caramel and vanilla notes with spicier undertones of oak and cinnamon.

Rolling Fork Spirits' historical significance, which dates back to 1911 with Prohibition-era medicinal whiskey ties, adds narrative appeal for those interested in whiskey lore. Following the rapid sell-out of the first batch of the Bourbon de Luxe Kentucky Straight Bourbon in 2024, this release reaffirms consumer demand for premium, small-batch Kentucky bourbons with heritage credentials.

title: Canned Creamy Espresso Martinis
description:
SABÉ Beverages has expanded its ready-to-drink cocktail line with a canned Espresso Martini offering. The new product arrives in 250 mL cans at 14% ABV and is packaged in packs of four. Designed as a premium yet accessible option for at-home consumption, the launch follows SABÉ Beverages' existing successful RTD cocktails like Margarita and Moscow Mule.

Consumers who opt in for the canned Espresso Martini experience will enjoy convenience and an indulgent coffee-forward profile that has not diminished in quality. In order to ensure the best experience possible, SABÉ Beverages uses real espresso beans in its formulation. Younger legal-drinking-age consumers, particularly millennials and Gen Z who have driven the Espresso Martini's recent 116% on-premise sales surge, may find the portable format ideal for social gatherings, outdoor events, or casual home consumption.

description:
Fresh Blends has introduced a certified organic beverage menu designed to meet the increasing demand for nutritious, clean-label drink options across institutional and retail settings. The new lineup includes fruit and vegetable smoothies, oat milk shakes, and iced refreshers, all formulated without artificial additives. The beverages also comply with USDA Smart Snack standards for school nutrition programs.

Ingredients in Fresh Blends' specially curated certified organic beverage menu are selected for both flavor and functional benefits — from the immune-supporting antioxidants in the Earth Berry Acai Smoothie to the anti-inflammatory properties of the Orange Carrot Ginger blend.

Produced in a facility with multiple food safety and sustainability certifications, Fresh Blends' ultra-nutricious and thoughtfully formulated beverage menu caters to health-conscious consumers in hospitals, educational institutions, and specialty grocery stores.

title: Gut-Friendly Pastas
description:
It's Skinny has expanded its product line with ready-to-eat pasta meals that aim to deliver gourmet flavors while accommodating contemporary dietary preferences. The new offerings include varieties such as the Truffle Parm, the Cacio e Pepe, and the Velvety Cheddar. These recipes combine the brand's signature zero-carb, gluten-free noodles with organic cheese sauces to provide a convenient yet elevated pasta experience.

Each ready-to-eat pasta meal in It's Skinny's latest venture contains seven grams or fewer of carbohydrates per serving and can be prepared in approximately five minutes. This ensures appeal for time-conscious consumers seeking healthier alternatives to traditional pasta dishes. The brand also highlights the use of premium ingredients in its ready-to-eat offerings, which helps it maintain rich taste profiles without excessive calories or sodium.

title: Modular Multifunctional Sofa Designs
description:
Cozey has introduced the Gaia sofa, a modular furniture piece designed to combine contemporary aesthetics with practical functionality. As part of its expanding lineup, the Gaia model emphasizes adaptability with its customizable layout capabilities. The piece can be reconfigured to suit different living spaces. The design incorporates high backrests and double-padded foam for enhanced comfort. Additionally, the sofa includes removable, washable slipcovers, making it a practical choice for households seeking durability and easy maintenance.

Cozey's modular furniture pieces, including the Gaia sofa, effectively balance affordability and premium features. Beyond its functional benefits and easy, tool-free assembly, the sofa reflects Cozey’s broader commitment to customer-driven innovation. The brand has incorporated consumer feedback in the design of the Gaia sofa and this helps it deliver products that better align with real-world use.

title: Glow-in-the-Dark Football Events
description:
The inaugural Battle at the Border Tournament in Vancouver marked a significant moment in youth sports as the initiative brought together elite football players from Canada and the United States for cross-border competition. Dylan Sidoo, Director of the Sidoo Family Giving Foundation, played a key role in supporting the event, which saw the U12 team from Air Raid Academy secure a division victory. His involvement reflects a broader commitment to fostering youth development through athletics, drawing from his own background as a former USC rugby player and advocate for sports-based mentorship.

The Battle at the Border Tournament provides young athletes with valuable exposure to high-level competition while promoting teamwork and perseverance. Parents and youth sports enthusiasts may find this initiative compelling as it highlights the importance of accessible athletic opportunities for children. The success of the U12 team demonstrates how structured programs can nurture talent and build confidence in young players. Additionally, the cross-border nature of the competition introduces a unique cultural exchange element.

title: Comprehensive Summer Lifestyle Capsules
description:
Justice, a prominent fashion retailer for tween girls, has partnered with Bandai Namco Entertainment to release a limited-edition PAC-MAN collection. The capsule commemorates the iconic arcade game’s 45th anniversary.

The Justice x Bandai Namco Entertainment limited-edition PAC-MAN collection includes summer-ready apparel and accessories such as swimwear, denim, varsity jackets, and crossbody bags. All of the silhouettes feature PAC-MAN’s signature graphics and retro game motifs. title: Ultra-Slim PC Fans
description:

title: Professional-Grade Solid-State Drives
description:
The Crucial X9 Pro 2TB SSD is a compact and high-performance external storage solution designed for professionals and general users alike. It features a USB 3.2 Gen 2 interface, offering read and write speeds of up to 1,050MB/s, which makes it suitable for tasks such as editing photos and videos directly from the drive. The X9 Pro is compatible with a wide range of devices, including Windows, Mac, Android, Linux, Xbox, and PlayStation, and comes preformatted in the exFAT file system for ease of use.

The SSD is backed by a five-year limited warranty, reflecting Crucial's confidence in its durability and performance. With its combination of speed, security, and portability, the Crucial X9 Pro 2TB SSD is positioned as a versatile option for users seeking reliable external storage solutions.

title: Industrial FPS Gaming Keyboards
description:
Corsair has introduced a new web-based firmware update utility, designed to simplify the process of updating firmware for its peripherals. This tool allows users to update devices such as keyboards, mice, and headsets directly through a web browser, eliminating the need to install additional software like Corsair's iCUE. The utility is optimized for popular browsers, including Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera, and is compatible with both Windows and Mac systems. Corsair is also testing support for Linux. Users can register their email to receive notifications about future firmware updates, and the utility is localized into 12 languages to enhance accessibility.

The web-based firmware update utility reflects Corsair's commitment to providing lightweight and flexible solutions for its customers. It offers a streamlined approach to keeping devices up-to-date, catering to users who prefer not to install software for firmware updates. Corsair plans to expand the utility's compatibility to include additional devices and features in the future. This development underscores the company's focus on user convenience and adaptability in the evolving landscape of gaming peripherals and technology.

title: Generative AI Interpreter Campaigns
description:
Samsung has announced the integration of Google Gemini AI into its home companion robot, Ballie, as part of an expanded partnership with Google Cloud. Ballie is designed to assist users with household management tasks, such as adjusting lighting, greeting visitors, and setting reminders, through natural conversational interactions. The robot leverages Gemini's multimodal reasoning capabilities alongside Samsung's proprietary language models to process audio, visual, and environmental data, enabling real-time behavioral adaptations. This collaboration builds on the successful integration of Gemini AI into Samsung's Galaxy smartphones, marking a strategic effort to embed generative AI across a broader range of devices.

Ballie is set to launch in the United States and South Korea during the summer of 2025. The robot's features include health and wellness support, offering tailored advice based on user inputs, such as exercise routines or sleep optimization strategies. Additionally, Ballie can provide styling recommendations by analyzing visual data captured through its camera. Samsung aims to position Ballie as a proactive smart home assistant, differentiating it from static voice aides by incorporating mobility and multimodal capabilities. This development underscores Samsung's ambition to redefine the role of AI in modern living environments.

title: At-Home Perimenopause Testing Systems
description:
Vibrant Wellness' new Hormone Zoomer is an advanced urine-based diagnostic panel that provides a multidimensional assessment of hormonal health by analyzing over 50 hormones, 13 endocrine disruptors, and key markers related to oxidative stress and bone turnover. This comprehensive test utilizes liquid chromatography and gas chromatography tandem mass spectrometry to deliver precise measurements of adrenal and sex hormones, including their metabolic pathways and breakdown products. The diagnostic panel also screens for environmental toxins like BPA and phthalates that may interfere with endocrine function. Vibrant Wellness includes bone degradation markers (DPD, PYD) and oxidative stress indicators (8-OHdG) to extend the test's utility beyond traditional hormone panels by connecting hormonal imbalances to broader aging and metabolic health concerns.

Results of Vibrant Wellness' new Hormone Zoomer are presented in an intuitive, clinician-friendly report that includes personalized supplement recommendations based on individual biomarker patterns, accompanied by gender-specific symptom questionnaires to contextualize findings.

Image Credit: Vibrant Wellness

title: Fifth-Generation SSDs
description:
Lexar has introduced the Play PRO 1TB MicroSD Express card, designed to meet the demands of high-performance gaming and data storage. This card is built on the MicroSD Express standard, which combines PCI Express 3.0 and NVMe 1.3 interfaces, enabling significantly faster data transfer speeds compared to traditional microSD cards. The Play PRO offers read speeds of up to 900MB/s and write speeds of up to 600MB/s, making it suitable for tasks such as accelerated game loading and high-speed data transfers. It is available in three capacities: 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB, with the 1TB model priced at $199.99. Additionally, the card is backward-compatible with UHS-I and UHS-II devices, though at reduced speeds.

The Play PRO 1TB MicroSD Express card is particularly notable for its compatibility with the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2, which exclusively supports the MicroSD Express format. This compatibility ensures that users can take full advantage of the card's high-speed capabilities for gaming applications. Lexar has also included a limited lifetime warranty and access to its recovery tool for restoring accidentally deleted or formatted files. With its advanced features and robust performance, the Play PRO 1TB MicroSD Express card positions itself as a valuable accessory for gamers and professionals requiring reliable and fast storage solutions.

title: High-Tech Personalized Wellness Partnerships
description:
Phasio and AMIS have announced a strategic partnership aimed at streamlining workflows in additive manufacturing. This collaboration integrates Phasio's digital production workflow solution with AMIS's build preparation software, creating a unified system for managing tasks from quoting to delivery. The combined solution automates routine processes, such as nesting and build preparation for 3D printers, while ensuring data accuracy and minimizing human errors. By leveraging this integration, users can optimize efficiency and scale their operations, addressing common challenges in digital manufacturing.

The partnership highlights the strengths of both companies in providing innovative solutions for the additive manufacturing industry. Phasio's platform focuses on connecting manufacturing customers with 3D printing services, while AMIS specializes in preparing builds for various 3D printing technologies, including binder jetting and selective laser sintering. Together, they aim to deliver a seamless digital ecosystem that enhances speed, accuracy, and overall operational performance. This collaboration underscores their commitment to advancing the capabilities of digital manufacturing service providers and production companies.

title: Boston Marathon Apparel
description:
The Terry Fox Foundation commemorates the 45th anniversary of Terry’s legendary Marathon of Hope with a bold new launch: the ‘Finish It’ Collection. This limited-edition apparel line, produced in collaboration with adidas, celebrates Terry’s enduring legacy while rallying Canadians to help finish the marathon he began against cancer.

title: Streamlined Work Desk Peripherals
description:
CalDigit has introduced its latest Thunderbolt 5 docking stations, the TS5 and TS5 Plus, designed to enhance connectivity and performance for Mac and PC users. The TS5 features 15 ports, including four Thunderbolt 5 connections, USB-A and USB-C ports, DisplayPort 1.4, and a 2.5Gb Ethernet port. It supports dual 6K displays and offers 140W host charging, making it suitable for power-intensive devices like Apple's 16-inch MacBook Pro. The TS5 Plus expands on this with 20 ports, including dual USB controllers for improved bandwidth and a 10Gb Ethernet port for faster network speeds. Both models leverage Thunderbolt 5 technology, providing up to 120Gb/s bandwidth for high-speed workflows and multi-display setups.

The TS5 and TS5 Plus are set to launch in North America and Europe between April and June 2025. The TS5 will be priced at $369.99 in the U.S. and €350 in Europe, while the TS5 Plus will cost $499.99 and €469, respectively. These docking stations aim to cater to professionals requiring robust connectivity solutions, offering support for high-resolution monitors, fast data transfer rates, and extensive charging capabilities. CalDigit's focus on performance and versatility positions the TS5 series as a significant upgrade over its predecessors, such as the TS4.

Image Credit: CalDigit

title: Third-Person Alien-Hunting Games
description:
Supergiant Games has announced that "Hades 2," the sequel to its critically acclaimed roguelike game, will be launching on both the Nintendo Switch and the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2. This marks the first console release for the game, which has been in early access on PC since May 2024. The developers have emphasized their commitment to optimizing the game for the enhanced hardware capabilities of the Switch 2, aiming for a consistent 60 frames per second performance. The game will also be available on the original Nintendo Switch, ensuring accessibility for players who have not yet upgraded to the new console.

The narrative of "Hades 2" centers on Melinoë, the younger sister of Zagreus, as she embarks on a journey to confront the Titan of Time. Supergiant Games has expanded the scope of the game, introducing new gods, weapons, and bosses while maintaining the core gameplay mechanics that made its predecessor a success. The decision to launch the game first on Nintendo consoles reflects the strong relationship between Supergiant Games and Nintendo, as the original "Hades" also debuted on the Switch before being ported to other platforms. A release date for the full version of "Hades 2" has not yet been confirmed.

title: AI Business Book Creators
description:
Inkitt, the Berlin-based publishing platform, is revolutionizing the traditional publishing model by leveraging AI technology to optimize storytelling based on reader engagement metrics. The platform discovers promising amateur writers through its free service, then selects successful stories for its premium Galatea subscription service where content undergoes algorithmic enhancement. Using large language models, Inkitt's editorial team optimizes plot developments, creates sequels, and adapts content for multiple formats including video through GalateaTV.

The approach has yielded impressive results, with monthly revenue reaching $10 million and backing from major Silicon Valley investors including Khosla Ventures. While traditional publishers cautiously explore AI applications, Inkitt fully embraces technology-driven content creation, with minimal editorial staff overseeing hundreds of authors. This innovative model demonstrates how data-driven publishing can democratize access for undiscovered writers while challenging conventional notions of authorship and creative control in the $151 billion global book publishing market.

description:
MemoGo is a group expense management app designed to simplify cost sharing among multiple users. Whether coordinating travel budgets, splitting rent with roommates, or tracking shared purchases, the platform offers a centralized, user-friendly solution.

Unlike spreadsheets or manual calculations, MemoGo automates the process, reducing the risk of errors and misunderstandings. title: Bite-Sized Gluten-Free Coolkies
description:
Tate's Bake Shop has announced the new Tate’s Soft Baked Cookies range as a series of sweet treats that will help to elevate the brand into its next phase as a sweet snack powerhouse. The product lineup was developed over the course of three years to get the recipe right and comes in two flavor varieties with a chocolate-forward profile including Chocolate Chip and Dark Chocolate Chunk. title: Parisian Patisserie Bakery Boxes
description:
Altro Foods' plant-based eggs offer a convenient, cost-conscious substitute for eggs that's as kind to animals as it is the planet. Made with nourishing, animal-free ingredients like pea proteins, nutritional yeast, lentil flour, bamboo and citrus fibers, Himalayan black salt, turmeric, onion powder, and black pepper, these plant-based eggs can be used for whipping up scrambles and omeletes, or in cooking and baking.

This powder is made to be combined with water and, optionally, oil for enhanced richness. Depending on the recipe or need, the plant-based egg alternative can provide a simple swap for a few eggs or a whole package.

As egg shortages and soaring prices continue to impact consumers, many are turning to plant-based egg alternatives like this one as a substitute.

title: Landscape Tonal Bike Series
description:
Pantone partnered with renowned designer Patricia Urquiola and global workspace innovator Haworth to present a limited-edition collection during Milan Design Week 2025. The collaboration introduces a custom version of the 'Cardigan Lounge' chair and an immersive installation titled 'Dualities Discovered,' featured within ELLE DECOR ALCHEMICA, an annual project by Elle Decor Italia curated by Urquiola.

The exhibition explores "transformation through the lens of color and sustainability, with a central sculptural interpretation of the Ouroboros—symbolizing infinity and renewal." Haworth’s sustainable materials are paired with Pantone’s Dualities palette, part of its 'Fashion, Home + Interiors (FHI)' range.

The selected hues—Pantone '15-3615 TCX Lavender Oil,' '14-0225 TCX Spring Leaf,' '14-1242 TCX Melon Ice,' and '12-2900 TCX Sweet Taffy'—balance vibrancy and softness, reinforcing the exhibition’s theme of opposing forces in harmony. Overall, this partnership demonstrates how thoughtfully applied color and design can reshape modern living and working environments.

title: Nutty Viral Chocolate Donuts
description:
Rich, crunchy and colorful Dubai chocolate has taken over social media, leading frozen dessert brand 16 Handles to take note and launch a Dubai Chocolate frozen yogurt flavor in mid-April.

This chilled take on the viral dessert features a creamy pistachio base with crushed milk chocolate bites and a touch of cocoa. This inside-out interpretation of the treat is vibrant and green, and frozen yogurt lovers who want to add to the experience can enhance the texture with additional toppings of their choosing.

Dubai Chocolate will be available at all participating 16 Handles stores nationwide, and it's poised to be just as much of a hit as previously released globally inspired varieties like Mango Lassi and the world's first Kulfi frozen yogurt.

title: Cyberpunk-Style Face Shavers
description:
At CES 2024, Panasonic announced the Panasonic Palm Shaver as a compact, five-blade shaver for use at home or on the go. The device lives up to its name with a palm-sized design and it's a small yet mighty shaver that delivers a close, smooth shave for every type of beard texture.

Powered by a linear motor, the Panasonic Palm Shaver (ES-PV6A-W) boasts advanced sensing technology so that every shave is customized to the user's unique facial contours and grooming needs. Notably, the Palm Shaver makes the most of NAGORI, a material created from sea minerals. Thanks to the use of this sustainable material, Panasonic reduces plastic usage by 40% when as compared to its conventional grooming products.

Also at the 2024 edition of the Consumer Electronics Show, Panasonic announced new attachments for its popular and modular MultiShape grooming system.

title: Ergonomic High-Performance Head Shavers
description:
The Handyman by Manscaped is an electric, compact face shaver and the brand's first-ever foil shaver for grooming on the go. This portable, quick-charging and waterproof grooming tool is supremely user-friendly, whether it's relied on for trimming, styling or fast touch-ups.

“Men are leading busier lifestyles than ever, but their grooming routines should never be compromised," says Paul Tran, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Manscaped, "With that in mind, we designed this premium, perfectly compact, and hygienic device so men can achieve that coveted clean-shaven, confident look and feel, even on the go.”

This electric face shaver boasts a sleek magnetic blade cover and features like a dual-action blade head with SkinSafe technology to reduce the risks of nicks and cuts. This stress-free shaver is well-suited to delivering a close shave, even on sensitive areas of the face, neck and jawline.

description:
Introducing the YOOSE Alloy MINI Shaver-Bounty Hunter is a new grooming device created for consumers looking to improve their portability and shave performance. The shaver is compact, drawing comparisons to wireless earbud cases for easy transport during commutes and long-haul travel. Made of zinc alloy, the shaver provides contours on its body that allow it to be held easily and comfortably, streamlining the process.

title: Layered Strawberry Puree Beverages
description:
Starbucks is embracing the growing popularity of cherry-inspired flavors with the introduction of its 'Cherry Cream Cold Foam,' offering customers a way to personalize their favorite beverages with a seasonal twist. This limited-time topping has inspired a wave of creative beverage combinations, as guests seek to enhance classic Starbucks offerings with a refreshing hint of cherry.

One such customization gaining popularity is the 'Iced Mocha with Cherry Cream Cold Foam'—a combination of Starbucks' "full-bodied espresso, rich mocha sauce, milk, and ice, finished with cherry cream cold foam and a cherry crunch topping." While not listed as an official menu item, this drink can be recreated by ordering an 'Iced Caffè Mocha,' removing the whipped cream, and adding Cherry Cream Cold Foam along with the 'Cherry Crunch Sweet Topping.'

Additionally, customers can explore further cherry-enhanced variations, such as a 'Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew with Cherry Cream Cold Foam' or a 'Strawberry Acai Lemonade Refresher' (ordered without strawberries and with two scoops of cherry powder). Overall, these personalized creations offer guests an elevated and seasonally inspired beverage experience.

title: Specialized Electric Two-Wheeler Ecosystems
description:
Allegro MicroSystems has introduced three new semiconductor solutions to target critical needs in electric mobility and industrial automation systems. These innovations reflect the company's strategic focus on high-growth sectors requiring advanced power management and motion control technologies.

Allegro MicroSystems' new semiconductor solutions include two precision current sensors (ACS37035 and ACS37630) and an automotive-grade fan driver IC (A89347). Each innovation is engineered to address specific technical challenges in next-generation applications. The ACS37035 sensor, for example, distinguishes itself with an exceptional 1MHz bandwidth and sub-microsecond response time. description:
West Fork Whiskey Co. has introduced a significant addition to its portfolio with the Old Hamer 10-Year Bourbon. The Indiana-distilled spirit stands out for its unconventional 99% corn mash bill. This composition figures as a deliberate nod to pre-Prohibition Hoosier whiskey traditions and results in a distinctly sweet flavor profile that differentiates it from mainstream bourbons.

title: Cost-Conscious AI Computing Systems
description:
IBM has unveiled the z17, its latest mainframe system designed specifically to handle enterprise-scale artificial intelligence workloads, including large language models and generative AI applications. The new iteration is represented as a significant evolution from previous models. It integrates AI capabilities across hardware, software, and operational management. IBM positions its z17 mainframe design as a comprehensive solution for businesses requiring high-performance, secure, and scalable AI infrastructure.

A key advancement in the z17 is its Telum II processor, which includes an on-chip AI accelerator capable of processing 450 billion inference operations daily with a response time of just one millisecond. This is. 50% improvement over the z16.

Additionally, IBM plans to introduce the Spyre Accelerator in late 2025, a PCIe card that will enhance generative AI performance. This upgrade will allow businesses to run AI assistants and agents directly on the mainframe without compromising data security.

Image Credit: IBM

title: Multi-Chat AI Systems
description:
ChatGPT Plus is free for college students across the U.S. and Canada through the end of May -- and it’s landing at the perfect time. As finals season kicks off, OpenAI is handing students access to its most advanced tools, including GPT-4o, image generation, voice mode, and in-depth research features, without the usual subscription cost.

This move goes beyond convenience. Students are already one of ChatGPT’s largest user groups, with millions using the platform not just for quick answers but to reshape how they learn, write, and solve complex problems. Now, more students, regardless of financial background, can tap into powerful AI support when it matters most.

To deepen the impact, OpenAI is also launching educational tools like OpenAI Academy and ChatGPT Lab, where students can learn AI fluency, swap prompts, and develop critical thinking skills.

title: Geometric Rocking Chair Concepts
description:
Fashion designer Jil Sander launched the jS Thonet collection highlighting reworked iterations of Marcel Breuer's work including the classic S 64 chair. It hit the spotlight during Milan Design Week along with other updated looks. The chair imaged from the lens of Sander sees the tubular steel chair imagined in two different collections dubbed Serious and Nordic.

She shared more on the design, "For me, the Serious line expresses concentration and focus. The shades of leather are subtle and yet the way the Bordeaux red, olive and black are fractured by the dominant graphite tone injects emotion into the chair's design. In these versions, I took a Nordic design approach, and also let myself be inspired by the sensuality of natural materials."

title: Braided Furniture Collections
description:
Design firm Atelier XÜK has created a unique design of a mining museum dubbed Huanglong Mountain Zisha Mineral Source Museum. It is defined by its glossy blue and brown tiles that are incorporated to reflect the look of mineral veins throughout the exterior. title: Mathematically Balanced Gins
description:
British design firm Foster + Partners Industrial Design introduces the Ori bird feeder at Milan Design Week. The main goal of the functional design is to reduce the spread of diseases. It is made to be easily dismantled to make the cleaning process a seamless step. This reduces the spread of diseases as it often happens when birds drop half-eaten food into the vessel.

Lead at Foster + Partners Industrial Design, Mike Holland shared with Dezeen, "Norman instigated the project so we started looking at the design of birdhouses and bird feeders. We started to glean quite a lot of information on bird feeders and actually found that many official bodies are identifying bird feeders as one of the key disease spreaders. It is really important to be able to thoroughly clean a bird feeder regularly, so we hit on this idea of a flat pack assembly of components that can easily be disassembled for transport, but also for cleaning."

Image Credit: Aaron Hargreaves
references:
Amy Duong — April 8, 2025 — Art & Design

title: Imaginative Cocktail Menus
description:
Singapore bar Fura unveiled the second edition of its Journal of Future Foods menu, using ingredients that are abundant, invasive, or prevalent to explore real-world impacts of climate change.

Alongside returning favorites from Volume One—like Get The Worm, a savory Margarita infused with mealworms—Volume Two features fresh additions like 3 Crop Corn, which highlights the benefits of crop diversification for low carbon emissions and supporting regenerative landscapes. Another drink on the menu, a Quail Walks Into a Martini, spotlights cell-cultured meat by reinventing the dry martini. This cocktail features a uniquely infused gin and dry vermouth, and caramelized fennel puree prepared with sous vide and fat-washed with gin.

The Journal of Future Foods Volume Two also shares a selection of snack plates crafted with the same intention as the drinks.

title: Auditory Artwork Albums
description:
British-Iranian artist Sara Khamis works together with the co-founder and art director of Sandro Lopex Milano on the new Kish o Mat. This is the Persian term that nods to the word 'checkmate' to honor the ancient game of chess with a collection of ceramic vessels made by hand.

title: Portable Ultrasonic Dishwashers
description:
Swiss bathroom brand Laufen works in collaboration with designer Yves Béhar to create the Volta sink. This is the first-ever product that is made using an electric kiln in the history of the brand's factory. It is a water-saving sink that is currently on display at Milan Design Week. It is crafted using the brand's electric tunnel kiln, ensuring that the system is entirely a zero-emissions process.

Marc Viardot, the marketing and design director of Roca Group -- the company that owns Laufen explains that the designer was given "carte blanche to create an icon." Viardot adds, [the sink was] "Inspired by the first CO2-free production in the world, Yves' approach was very fresh and resulted in an unconventional new concept for the bathroom. It feels a bit like we reinvented the wheel – at least the way we relate to the daily use of water."

Image Credit: Laufen

title: Pediatric Dental AI Technology
description:
Colgate's Oral Health Movement is an initiative that invites consumers in India to level up their oral health with a personalized, instant, AI-generated dental screening report through a simple WhatsApp interaction.

In partnership with Logy.AI, Colgate developed an AI dental screening tool that can be accessed in nine leading Indian languages simply by scanning the QR code on Colgate product packs. After answering a few questions and uploading images of their mouth, participants will get a free report.

title: Chocolatey British Butters
description:
The Almond Butter and Chocolate masterclass is being expanded by the Almond Board of California (ABC) through a collaboration with the Culinary Institute of America (CIA) to offer professionals new tips and techniques to take advantage of.

The course features chefs Anissa Dann and Robert Jorin who will highlight the various roles that almond butter can play in a variety of chocolate applications. Food professionals will learn how the industry is changing and how to stay ahead of the curve in the face of changing consumer preferences, industry challenges and more.

Associate Director of Trade Marketing & Stewardship at the ABC Harbinder Maan spoke on the Almond Butter and Chocolate masterclass saying, "With demand for premium, better-for-you and plant-based chocolates on the rise, confectioners are tasked with innovating for consumers while also navigating supply challenges. Working with the Culinary Institute of America was a natural evolution of our masterclass given their rich culinary curriculum and global reach. Through this masterclass, we aim to equip chefs and chocolatiers with the knowledge and inspiration to push the boundaries of chocolate innovation.”

The UMMA Diamond Sonic Toothbrush from TAO Clean is an advanced oral care device designed to deliver superior cleaning performance. It utilizes sonic technology to produce 40,000 brush strokes per minute, effectively removing plaque and surface stains while promoting healthier gums. The toothbrush features two brushing modes—regular cleaning and gentle cleaning—catering to diverse oral care needs, including those with sensitive teeth and gums. Its ergonomic design ensures ease of use, while the built-in timer with 30-second intervals encourages thorough brushing by guiding users to clean each quadrant of their mouth.

With its combination of advanced technology and user-friendly design, the UMMA Diamond Sonic Toothbrush represents a comprehensive solution for maintaining optimal oral hygiene.

title: Sporty Collaborative Streetwear Capsules
description:
The Dr. Martens x Palace collaboration debuts on April 11, presenting three unique interpretations of the classic '1461' silhouette. This release pays tribute to a 1988 trend in which Grolsch swing-top bottle caps were used as lace embellishments—a style made popular by Matt Goss of the band Bros. Wedel White Chocolate & Pistachio liqueur has been created in collaboration between the Polish vodka brand and the Polish confectionery brand as a dessert-inspired option for consumers to pick up this season. description:
In a unique fusion of culinary and couture artistry, Wisconsin Cheese has launched the 'Rinds & Roses Collection by Christine A. Moore for Wisconsin Cheese.' Created in collaboration with the iconic Kentucky Derby milliner, this limited-edition line features handcrafted “fromaginators”—whimsical hats inspired by fine artisan cheeses.

description:
BioCraft Pet Nutrition and Prefera Petfood have partnered on a new cultivated mouse cat food that would prioritize high-quality nutrition and protein alongside sustainability.

description:

title: Mobile Reading Accessories
description:
While lock boxes are commonly used to keep phones from disturbing certain social experiences, The Flipper by Heineken is a phone case that offers a more organic solution with a nifty AI integration and a physical mechanism.

Upon hearing "cheers," The Flipper turns itself upside down to keep the good times going. This phone case for #SocialOffSocials launched in response to statistics that state 47% of people are glued to their screens, even in social settings. With the screen side of a phone facing down on a table, people are less likely to be pulled into using their phone, doomscrolling, checking notifications, or otherwise ignoring the very real interactions going on around them.

The Flipper is a prototype, but in the meantime, people can still manually flip their phones over to avoid digital distractions.

description:
Marc Jacobs debuts 'Bark Jacobs,' a whimsical and heartfelt month-long celebration designed for pet lovers and their four-legged companions. Throughout April—recognized as National Pet Month—shoppers can transform their favorite Marc Jacobs leather goods into one-of-a-kind mementos with custom, hand-painted pet portraits. title: 2-in-1 Flossing Toothbrushes
description:
The AutoFlo+ from Kenvue is a fully automated toothbrush designed specifically for children, aiming to simplify and enhance their oral care routine. This innovative device features the OptiClean brush head, equipped with 34,000 bristles to deliver superior cleaning performance, removing up to seven times more plaque in hard-to-reach areas compared to manual brushing. The AutoFlo+ integrates multiple functionalities, including automated toothpaste dispensing, thorough cleaning, and liquid suction, ensuring a mess-free and efficient brushing experience. Its gentle yet effective design is clinically proven to provide consistent cleaning while being safe for young teeth and gums.

In addition to its functional benefits, the AutoFlo+ incorporates an interactive app that engages children with countdowns and rewards, making brushing a fun and motivating activity. The app also allows parents to monitor brushing history and set reminders, fostering better oral hygiene habits. The device's mess-free design, supported by continuous suction, simplifies cleanup for busy families. With its emphasis on convenience, effectiveness, and child-friendly features, the AutoFlo+ represents a significant advancement in pediatric oral care technology.

title: Multi-Benefit Lip Treatments
description:
Guava Granita is a juicy new gourmand fragrance from Ellis Brooklyn that pairs tropical guava, banana, and mango blossom with a rich base of vanilla and almond milk.

Featuring 94.2% biodegradable ingredients, 18.4% renewable ingredients, and 3% upcycled ingredients, Guava Granita opens with top notes of guava juice, banana, and bergamot, complemented by the light freshness of tropical waterlily.
